attempts.sql: WITH RECURSIVE api AS (SELECT symbol_id AS class_symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols WHERE symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/server/models.py::ApiModel' AND kind = 'class'), inherit AS (SELECT a.class_symbol_id, 0 AS depth, [a.class_symbol_id] AS path FROM api AS a UNION ALL SELECT cb.class_symbol_id, i.depth + 1, list_append(i.path, cb.class_symbol_id) FROM inherit AS i JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb ON cb.base_symbol_id = i.class_symbol_id WHERE i.depth < 50 AND NOT list_contains(i.path, cb.class_symbol_id)), direct AS (SELECT DISTINCT cb.class_symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb WHERE cb.base_name IN ('ApiModel', '_Payload') OR cb.base_symbol_id = (SELECT class_symbol_id FROM api)) SELECT i.class_symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, MIN(i.depth) AS depth FROM inherit AS i JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS s ON s.symbol_id = i.class_symbol_id AND s.kind = 'class' LEFT JOIN direct AS d ON d.class_symbol_id = i.class_symbol_id WHERE i.depth >= 2 AND d.class_symbol_id IS NULL GROUP BY i.class_symbol_id ORDER BY i.class_symbol_id

request:
Which classes inherit from ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/models.py) only indirectly, i.e. through at least one intermediate class of this repository, and do not name ApiModel directly in their class statement? An import alias of ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/responses.py imports it as _Payload) counts as naming ApiModel directly, and a subscripted base such as ListResponse[T] counts as its class. For each, give the class symbol ID and the length of the shortest inheritance chain to ApiModel (2 when the parent class directly subclasses ApiModel).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), depth (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This query walks the inheritance graph from the ApiModel class symbol using the class-bases edges, seeding ApiModel at depth 0 so a direct subclass is depth 1 and a class reached through one intermediate class is depth 2. It keeps classes whose shortest path to ApiModel has at least one intermediate class and drops any class that names ApiModel directly, including bases written as the _Payload alias or resolved to the ApiModel symbol. Results are grouped per class to take the shortest chain length and ordered by symbol ID.
